questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (1) in the passage "The Newspaper Vendor".
questions.explanation:
"Rise" is intransitive and means to get up from bed, which fits getting up before dawn.
"Raises" and "rouses" need an object (raise something, rouse someone), and "resides" means lives in a place, so none of them completes the sentence.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that fits blank (5) in the passage "The Newspaper Vendor".
questions.explanation:
The blank needs a verb that takes "a career" as its object and fits a hope for the daughter's future.
"Pursue" means to follow or work towards a career, so "Murugan hopes his daughter will pursue a career in teaching" is natural and correct.
"Persecute" means to harass cruelly, "perish" means to die (and takes no object), and "pester" means to annoy; none of these can be paired with a career.
